name: CrewAI
shortDescription: Open-source framework for crews of role-based agents that split a job into tasks.
longDescription: CrewAI is the crew-style option in this catalog: you define roles and tasks, and the Python library coordinates them. The open-source package and the hosted product are separate. Figures below are only what we could read on the pricing page during the October 15, 2026 check.
pricingNotes: Enterprise Custom. Open-source framework separate from cloud Free/Enterprise.
freeTierNotes: Basic plan Free: visual editor, GitHub integration, 50 workflow executions/month (cloud). OSS/framework also installable via pip/uv without cloud.
bestFor: Multi-step jobs you can split across roles
Python teams who want a crew abstraction they can install
notIdealFor: A single chat box with no workflow
Teams that only want a closed SaaS and will not touch Python
smokeTestNotes: Install/import only; no API key, no LLM invoke, no signup.
